response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(signal_count) AS total_signal_count
  FROM telescope_counts
)
SELECT tc.telescref,
       tc.signal_count,
       CAST(tc.signal_count AS REAL) / t.total_signal_count AS share_of_all_signals
FROM telescope_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE t.total_signal_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_of_all_signals DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Unrounded fraction” means return the numeric quotient without rounding it for display; SQLite floating-point division is used.
